source.title: Ernesto Gutiérrez Cuba wins Campeonato Sudamericano 2013
source.content: [Ernesto Gutiérrez Cuba](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2011CUBA02) won the [Campeonato Sudamericano 2013](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/c.php?i=CampeonatoSudamericano2013) with an average of 13.58 seconds. [José Garrido](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2009GARR01) finished second (14.08) and [Marvin Castañeda Cruzado](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2011CRUZ01) finished third (14.78).

translation.title: Ernesto Gutiérrez Cuba 夺得 2013 年南美锦标赛冠军
translation.content: [Ernesto Gutiérrez Cuba](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2011CUBA02) 以 13.58 秒的平均成绩赢得了 [2013 年南美锦标赛](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/c.php?i=CampeonatoSudamericano2013)冠军。[José Garrido](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2009GARR01) 以 14.08 秒获得亚军，[Marvin Castañeda Cruzado](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2011CRUZ01) 以 14.78 秒获得季军。
